svg.title: Suriyaprakash Palanisamy, Senior Software Engineer
svg.desc: Animated deep-space banner: a three-layer parallax starfield drifts over violet, teal and magenta nebulae while the name Suriyaprakash Palanisamy ignites letter by letter above a planet horizon at sunrise. Below: Senior Software Engineer. Backend, Cloud, ML platforms, AI-driven development. Now building FastAPI microservices that serve ML forecasting models at Freddie Mac.
